Slop Gallery · In development

Photo gallery

Your photo library, on this device.

Open now

Slop Gallery has these main features: Timeline, albums & favourites; Sort mode: like, dislike and tag. It opens Any image.

In development: some features listed below may not be finished yet.

What you can do with Slop Gallery

  • Find and remove duplicate photos
  • Organise your photos without a cloud
